# Vendored public calculation modules

Source: https://github.com/Vespa314/chan.py

Commit: f8ca3b5e44d7166e2abd756a8e7fa816c79faebe

Upstream copyright: Copyright (c) 2022 Memos. License: MIT; see LICENSE.

Only the unchanged Python calculation modules required by the isolated adapter
are included: Bi, BuySellPoint, Combiner, Common, KLine, Math, Seg, ZS and
ChanConfig.py and ChanModel/Features.py. No proprietary full-version functionality is included. The
AI-QUANT adapter and its observation protocol live outside this directory.
